## Summary

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem

What problem would this feature solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature should work.

## Repository / Component

Which LifyX repository, integration or component would this apply to?

## Use Case

Explain how developers or users would benefit from this feature.

## Alternatives

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you considered.

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, examples or other relevant information if useful.

Do not include:

- Private keys
- Seed phrases
- API secrets
- Access tokens
- Production credentials
